COURT'S OR JUDGE'S ORDERS No.
 and Registrar's  order with  Signatures  C528/575/2026  Hon'ble Alok Mahra, J.
Mr. Vikas Bahuguna, learned counsel for the applicant.
2. Mr. V.S. Pal, learned A.G.A. along with Mr. Nikhil Bisht, learned Brief Holder for the State.

3. Present C-528 application has been filed seeking quashing chargsheet, cognizance/summoning order dated 03.02.2022 passed by learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Dehradun under Section 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 and 120-B I.P.C. in Criminal Case No.1441 of 2022 as well as the entire proceedings of the aforesaid criminal case.
4.
Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that an F.I.R. was lodged by respondent no.2/complainant regarding a land transaction.

In the F.I.R., it has been alleged that the applicant and other co-accused persons, in furtherance of a criminal conspiracy, prepared forged documents and got a sale deed executed in respect of land which allegedly did not belong to them, thereby causing wrongful loss to the complainant.
After investigation, the Investigating Officer submitted a charge- sheet against the applicant, on the basis of which the learned trial court took cognizance.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant would further submit that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case; that, the applicant has been charge-sheeted only on the basis of the statements of the complainant and another co-accused person; that, there is no independent evidence against the applicant.
It is also submitted that the applicant is neither a witness to the alleged sale deed nor a beneficiary of any money arising from the said transaction.
Therefore, criminal proceedings against the applicant are unsustainable in the eyes of law.

6. Issue notice to respondent no.2, returnable within six weeks.
7.
Steps to
be taken within one week.

8. List after service of notice upon respondent no.2.
9.
Objections, if any, be filed by the State/respondent.

11. Stay application stands disposed of.
